title: Log a missing Engram source basis once per workspace, not twice per turn
outcome: Found by the tm-winf step-1 round-3 review (Claude /review-code, Note). engram_execution_source_basis (src/engram_turn_observations.rs) logs 'engram> no source basis for workspace ...' at both the begin-time and the closing capture of every claimed turn whose workdir cannot be fingerprinted. For a workspace that is not a worktree root (a non-Git project, a session rooted in a repository subdirectory, or a repository with configured clean/smudge/process filters, which review_freeze rejects) that is an expected, documented state, so the line repeats twice per turn indefinitely, and each attempt still spawns 'git rev-parse' and the filter check. Fix direction: distinguish 'not a worktree root / unsupported repository' from a genuine capture failure (deadline, Git error, unreadable untracked input); log the former once per session and workdir (or cache the verdict until the workdir changes), and keep logging real failures.
